Om. Even above that, Badarayana [states this] by virtue of possibility. 1/3/26

It has been stated that only human beings are qualified for the study of the Vedas. The qualifier “human” was stated in contrast to animals and so on, and not in contrast to gods and so on. He says: “Even above that, [the qualification applies] to Badarayana [the author of the Brahma Sutras] by virtue of possibility.” Above that, for the humans who are the gods, having attained the status of gods, it is possible [for them to be qualified], due to their possession of a special intellect and so on. For animals and so on, it is not possible, due to the absence of that [special intellect]. Even for them, where there is the possession of a special intellect and so on, there is no contradiction, due to the absence of a prohibition. For, old men and the like are seen [to be qualified].
